stats.title: Statistics
stats.topBlocksInfoLabel: About top blocks and bar chart
stats.topBlocksInfoMessage:
The 4 blocks show today's numbers; the bar chart shows one week of the selected block.

Streak: consecutive study days
* The chart shows studied or not (0/1)
Done: cards studied
Due: cards to study
New: cards created

Note: "New" in the Study tab and card lists means unlearned cards — a different meaning.
stats.recordModeContinuityNote: * Consistency is the share of days you've studied without skipping, from your first day until today. Keep studying every day to maintain 100%.
stats.activityHeatmapInfoMessage:

settings.initialFilterInfo: Default filter shown on the card list, Study, and Stats screens. "Last" remembers the filter you used previously.
settings.fsrsLockedSubtitle: Upgrade to Pro to optimize your learning style
settings.fsrsRetentionInfo: Target probability of recalling a card at its next review. Higher values mean more frequent reviews and better recall. Changes apply only to cards reviewed from now on.
settings.studyTimerBreakNotice:
A break is inserted between study intervals. Even on another screen or with the app closed, a notification tells you when the break ends (if notifications aren't allowed, it switches to the next study timer when you return to the study screen).
Set it to "None" (0 min) to skip breaks and continue straight to the next set (the current set shows as "⏱ N min (2/5)").
settings.studyTimerInfo:
The timer only advances on the study screen (it auto-pauses when you leave the screen or close the app). It continues from the remaining time across decks, and starts fresh at the next session after time is up or it ends.

[Tap]
- While shown: pause/resume
- While hidden ("At start" mode): re-show for a few seconds
* If both circle and time are "Off": pause/resume

[Long-press]
- Normal timer: restart/stop
- Break timer: skip/stop
settings.studyTimerCyclesInfo: Set the repeat count to 2 or more to enable break time. You can also use it as a Pomodoro timer, e.g. repeating "25 min study → 5 min break" four times.
settings.studyTimerRingInfo:
Starts as a full circle and empties clockwise as time passes. When the circle is gone, time is up.
- Always: always show the circle
- At start: show for a few seconds after starting
- Off: don't show the circle
settings.studyTimerTimeInfo:
Shows minutes until under 1 minute remains, then seconds.
- Always: always show the remaining time
- At start: show for a few seconds after starting
- Off: don't show the remaining time
settings.studyTimerEndInfo:
- Alert: notifies you when time is up and lets you choose Resume/Finish
- Blink only: the circle blinks; tap to stop

dataManagement.title: Data Management
dataManagement.exportInfo: Exports all decks, cards, tags, study history, and settings as a JSON file. Use it to migrate to another device or to restore data if it is lost.
dataManagement.importInfo: Restores from a backup JSON file. Choose between "Merge" and "Replace All." "Replace All" deletes all current data, so use with caution.
dataManagement.importReplaceConfirmMessage:
All current decks, cards, tags, and study history will be deleted and replaced with the imported data. 
This cannot be undone.
dataManagement.exportImageMessage: Including images increases the file size.
dataManagement.exportLargeSizeMessage:
Approx. {{size}} MB.
Files over 100 MB may affect export and import performance.
Continue?
dataManagement.exportTsvInfo: Exports cards of the selected deck as a TSV (tab-separated) file. You can open and edit it in spreadsheet apps like Numbers. Study history and code/image blocks are not included (converted to plain text).
dataManagement.importTsvInfo: Adds or updates cards from a TSV file (.tsv) or a tab-separated text file (.txt). Files created or edited in Numbers also work. To create a new file from scratch, add a header row with the columns id, front, back, memo, tags in this order (tags can be separated by commas for multiple tags). Leave id blank to add new cards. Keep the id to overwrite existing cards.
dataManagement.tsvExportNoteMessage:
Please note the following:

■ Study history is not included
■ Code and image blocks are converted to plain text (they cannot be restored on re-import)
■ Multiple text blocks are merged into one (they are not split back on re-import)
dataManagement.tsvImportNoteMessage:
To update existing cards, keep the id column.
Removing or changing the id will create new cards instead.
dataManagement.tsvImportChoiceMessage:

sync.title: iCloud Sync
sync.lockedSubtitle: Upgrade to Pro to sync data across devices
sync.description: Sync data across devices signed in to the same Apple ID
sync.descriptionDetail:
iCloud sync happens at these times:
・Receive (auto): opening the app
・Send (auto): closing the app
・Send & receive (manual): tapping "Sync Now"
Data is stored in iCloud Drive and is not shared with anyone outside of Apple.
sync.termsHelp:
Last synced: when data was actually transferred
Last checked: when data was reconciled with iCloud
iCloud: latest data timestamp on iCloud
sync.iCloudUnavailable: iCloud is unavailable. Enable iCloud Drive in Settings.
sync.offline: You're offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
sync.offlinePending: You're offline. Your changes will sync to iCloud once you reconnect.
sync.conflictOverwritten: Updated with newer data from another device. Your previous edits and study on this device can be restored from Restore Data.
sync.schemaVersionMismatch: Data was synced by a newer version of the app. Please update.
sync.syncTimeout: Sync timed out. Check your connection and try again in a moment
sync.storageFull: Not enough iCloud storage. Free up some space and try again
sync.advancedSectionInfo: Use these as a last resort, for example when neither Sync Now nor Restore Data resolves the problem.
sync.forceUploadInfo: Overwrites iCloud with this device's data. Usually not needed; use it when you want to reflect this device's data on another device.
sync.forceUploadConfirm:
Force upload local data to iCloud.
Existing iCloud data will be overwritten. Continue?
sync.forceDownloadInfo: Overwrites this device with iCloud's data. Usually not needed; use it when you want to pull in the latest data that another device uploaded to iCloud.
sync.forceDownloadConfirm:
Force download iCloud data to this device.
Local data will be replaced. Continue?
sync.forceDownloadConfirmAt:
Force download the iCloud data ({{datetime}}) to this device.
Local data will be replaced. Continue?
sync.resetRemoteInfo: A last resort for when sync isn't working or data differs between devices and nothing else fixes it. Rebuilds iCloud from this device's current data. Your on-device data is not deleted.
sync.resetRemoteConfirm:
Delete all iCloud backups and rebuild from this device's current data.
Any unsynced data on other devices will be lost. Continue?
sync.resetRemoteSuccess: iCloud has been rebuilt from this device's current data.
sync.restoreSectionInfo: If you study or edit on multiple devices while offline, sync keeps the data from whichever device recorded most recently. On the device that was overwritten, you can roll back to the pre-sync data or add/overwrite the differences.
sync.restoreInfo: Restore from automatic backups (last 3). Backups are created automatically just before sync replaces your data.
sync.restoreNone:
No backups available to restore.
Backups are created automatically just before sync replaces your data.
sync.restoreSelectMessage: Choose a point to restore. Your current data will be replaced with this backup.
sync.restoreConfirmMessage: Replace current data with the backup from {{datetime}}. Continue?
sync.mergeInfo: Pull a single deck from an automatic backup and merge it into your current data. Study progress and history are kept per card (newest wins) and nothing existing is deleted.
sync.mergeSelectDeckMessage: Choose a deck to merge into your current data. Existing data will not be deleted.
sync.mergeConfirmMessage: Merge "{{name}}" into your current data. Existing data will not be deleted. Continue?
